title: Director AI & Automation
description:
Your Mission We are looking for a Director AI & Automation to join our management team and take full ownership of our technology strategy, architecture, and AI transformation. You will own technical decision making for OMC, and you will be the driving force behind embedding AI across everything we build and deliver, both internally and for our clients.
 The foundation for this is already in place. We have been working with AI and Machine Learning for years, and have long implemented services like predictive lead scoring for our clients. What started as pockets of expertise across the consultancy has now grown into something central to our strategy, and we are professionalizing it accordingly. What we need now is someone to own this transformation end to end and take it to the next level, a role important enough to warrant its own dedicated seat in management.
 You will work in direct, close collaboration with the rest of the management team on overall strategy, consulting/delivery alignment, and on how technology and AI translate into revenue and market positioning.
 What You'll Own Technology & Architecture
 Full ownership of technical and architectural decisions across OMC's systems
 Definition and evolution of our internal and client facing technology stack
 AI Transformation
 Design and drive OMC's AI first strategy end to end, from internal tooling to client facing service offerings
 Build and codify AI first productized service offerings we can sell to enterprise clients, including methodology, pricing, and delivery model
 Client Delivery
 Lead client engagements on Marketo/Adobe and Molequle architecture, including integrations with CRM and other systems in the client's MarTech stack
 Lead client engagements focused on AI adoption and AI augmented delivery within the Adobe/Marketo space
 Embed AI into our delivery practice through tooling, playbooks, and governance frameworks

title: Senior Manager, Social Media Management
description:
Short title Build brand communities on social media
 Introduction You don't just manage social media, you shape how brands show up on it. As a Senior Social Media Manager at Pulse Advertising, you lead multi-platform strategies for global brand accounts, drive creative direction, and set the standard for platform-native excellence. You know what's about to peak on TikTok before it peaks, and you're as strong creatively as you are strategically, ideating concepts in a client workshop and owning their execution the next day. You're a trusted senior partner to clients and a go-to voice internally, someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just outputs. If you're ready to lead at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and impact, this is your next chapter.
 Your tasks You own TikTok-first content strategies for key global brand accounts, defining platform-native formats, content pillars, and creative direction that drive measurable engagement and business results
 You lead content planning and execution across TikTok, Reels, Stories, and complementary formats, ensuring every channel feels native, intentional, and on-brand
 You manage social media across multiple brands within a single parent account, adapting global content frameworks for regional markets with a particular focus on DACH
 You act as a senior client partner, steering projects from briefing to delivery, proactively shaping agendas and challenging briefs that don't align with platform or audience reality
 You track, synthesise, and present performance data, translating complex analytics into sharp client-ready insights and actionable recommendations
 You mentor junior and mid-level team members and contribute to pitches and new business proposals, bringing your platform expertise to grow both the team and the account base

title: Solution Architect – Client Solutions (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Herausforderungen Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unseren Entwicklungsteams und verbringst einen wesentlichen Teil deiner Zeit im direkten Austausch mit Kunden. Du hörst genau hin, verstehst die Kundenprobleme und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Fragestellungen, die unsere Entwickler konkret bearbeiten können. Auf Basis deines tiefen technischen Hintergrunds entwickelst du Lösungsarchitekturen , die sowohl zu den Anforderungen des Kunden als auch zu unserer eigenen Systemlandschaft passen. Dabei denkst du in Systemen : Du verstehst unsere Architektur, die technische Umgebung unserer Kunden, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten und kannst diese Welten sinnvoll zusammenbringen. Bei APIs und Integrationen kannst du nicht nur Anforderungen formulieren, sondern auch auf technischer Ebene mit unseren Entwicklern über Lösungswege und deren Auswirkungen diskutieren. Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten technischen Idee auch eine funktionierende Lösung wird. Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Engineering sorgst du für Klarheit : Was ist das eigentliche Problem? Was brauchen wir technisch? Was ist sinnvoll umsetzbar? Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Themen, koordinierst unterschiedliche Stakeholder und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick.
 Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Product Management, Softwareentwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Business und Technologie. Ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Softwarearchitekturen, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und API-Design. Ein Entwicklerhintergrund ist dabei ein klarer Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
